title: Software Developer
description:
Job title: Software Developer

Location: Gobichettipalayam,Erode

Salary: based on interview

Type: Contractual

Experience: 1\-3 years

Job Summary:

Shastika Global Impex private limited is looking for a Software Developer

who can independently handle and manage our entire ERP system \- from

development to deployment and support.

Key Responsibilities:

ERP Development \& Management:

\- Fully handle ERP system \- development, customization, implementation \&

maintenance

\- Develop and modify ERP modules as per business requirements

\- Manage ERP database, backend logic, and front\-end interface

Technical Responsibilities:

\- Strong knowledge of any ERP tech stack (PHP / Python / .NET / Java) \+

MySQL / SQL Server

\- Handle ERP integrations with other tools / APIs

\- Fix bugs, optimize performance, and ensure ERP security

\- Create reports, dashboards, and automations in ERP

Business Support:

\- Understand requirements from all departments (Sales, Purchase, Accounts,

Inventory)

\- Provide ERP training and technical support to staff

\- Ensure smooth daily operations of ERP without downtime

\- Manage data backup, user roles, and permissions

Requirements:

\- B.E / http://B.Tech / MCA / http://M.Sc IT background

\- 1\+ years hands\-on experience with any ERP system (Custom ERP, Odoo,

SAP B1, ERPNext preferred)

\- Good knowledge of Coding, Database Management \& Server handling

\- Problem\-solving attitude and ability to work independently

Pay: ₹18,000\.00 \- ₹25,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person
